messages:
Alice K.: Heads-up: after flipping runtime->attention=flashattn:v3 on a subset of canary hosts we see a 6-11% throughput drop for mid‑seq (seq~512, batch 8) workloads vs v2. Latency p50 is same, p95 up ~8%. Anyone seen this pattern?
Ben P.: Interesting. Which GPU + kernel compile flags? v3 pulls in different tiling heuristics, could be workspace fragmentation.
Alice K.: A100-80GB, CUDA 11.8. Runtime built with -O3, cublas/tiling enabled. We pinned math to fp16. v2 numbers: 1020 tok/s, v3: 940 tok/s on same host. These repro on a single model (redwood-3b-fp16) only at medium seq lengths.
Jin R.: Two ideas: (1) v3 introduced a prefetch for KV cache that changes L2 traffic for mid seq; (2) our workspace pool allocator might choose a different placement and force extra memset. Both can hit throughput without changing p50 much.
Omar V.: Also check quantization path. If model has any custom quantized ops we might be falling back to a slower path in v3. Did you see any kernel fallback logs?
Alice K.: I grep'd dmesg/runtime logs, saw a few lines: "flashattn_v3: fallback kernel chosen (shape mismatch)" but they were sparse. Attaching minimal log snippet:

```
[2025-04-23T14:12:07Z] flashattn_v3: qkv_tile=128->fallback
[2025-04-23T14:12:07Z] flashattn_v3: workspace_alloc remapped 512MB->768MB
[2025-04-23T14:12:07Z] runtime: kernel_launch time +1.8ms
```

Ben P.: That workspace remap is suspicious. v3 allows larger contiguous workspace in some paths which can increase memcpy. Can you capture per-kernel timelines with nvprof/nsys? Even a single-step trace helps.
Lina M.: I can spin a repro cluster if you give the run command. Want me to run on dedicated A100 hosts and collect nsys and our kernel telemetry? I can schedule it now.
Alice K.: Yes please. Repro command (toy):

```
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ./serve_test --model redwood-3b-fp16 \
  --batch_size 8 --max_seq_len 512 --prompt_len 64 --iters 500 \
  --attention flashattn:v3 --collect-telemetry
```

Also try --attention=flashattn:v2 for baseline.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for runtime:flashattn-v3 -> hosts: canary-group-4 (3 nodes). CI checks: unit, smoke.
Jin R.: If you can get an nsys timeline, look for extra cudaMemcpyAsync or cudaMemset calls right before kernels. Also inspect kernel grid sizes: v3 has slightly different launch config for seq in [384,768].
Omar V.: Another theory: our kernel selection heuristic uses a cost model—v3 changed constants. For batch=8/seq=512 the model might prefer fewer larger kernels which reduce parallelism on sms. Could explain same p50 but worse throughput.
Ben P.: Quick experiment: try lowering batch to 6 or increase batch to 12 to see trend. If it's parallelism packing issue numbers should scale non‑linearly.
Alice K.: I tried batch 4 (tok/s 610) and batch 16 (tok/s 1750) — both are roughly proportional but v3 delta persists ~8-10% across batches. So not purely packing.
Lina M.: I'll run the nsys + runtime kernel telemetry now, and also toggle the allocator mode (env var WORKSPACE_ALLOC=pool vs slab) to see if remapping disappears.
Omar V.: If you can also collect the kernel names and SM occupancy from nsys that helps. I'll check the cost-model diff and push a small diagnostic build that emits the selected kernel variant per layer.
Alice K.: Great — thanks. If we confirm it's the workspace remap/memset we can try a quick workaround: force smaller workspace limit for v3 (env FLASHATTN_MAX_WS=512MB) and see if throughput restores.
Ben P.: If that helps, we still need to fix heuristic. I'll open an RFC follow-up with perf numbers and suggested guardrails for the allocator.
Jin R.: Post the nsys tar here when ready. If we want faster triage, I can run a microkernel-only bench that reproduces kernel choice without the rest of runtime.
Alice K.: Uploading results to s3://redwood-ci/flashattn/v3-midseq-1778881111.tar.gz once done. Will post here.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed: 3/3 hosts updated. Smoke: PASS. Metric: alert if p95 latency +10% for 10m.
Lina M.: nsys + telemetry uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/flashattn/v3-midseq-1778881111/nsys.tar.gz
Omar V.: I looked at the telemetry quick. v3 picks "fa_v3_tile128x32" for layer ranges where v2 used "fa_v2_tile64x64". Occupancy drops ~6% on those kernels. Also saw 1 memcopy (~0.9ms) per step for workspace remap. That matches observed delta.
Alice K.: Good catch. Next steps: (1) temp workaround env to limit ws, (2) Jin/Omar to update heuristic to penalize remap cost, (3) add a telemetry counter for remap events so we can alert. I'll file tickets and assign. Thanks everyone :pray:
Ben P.: sgtm. Also add a unit perf test in CI for seq 512 batch 8 so we catch regressions.
Jin R.: Will do. I'll tag the RFC follow-up: rfc-2025-03-attn-kernel-selection.ary
Omar V.: Opening PR with diagnostic logs and a small heuristic tweak, linking the tickets.
Alice K.: Closing loop: after forcing FLASHATTN_MAX_WS=512MB on canaries, tok/s returned to baseline within noise. We'll keep canary running for 24h and then promote once green. :thumbsup:
